set_support_chunking: set the global SUPPORT_CHUNKING flag to enable or disable prefill chunking
get_support_chunking: get the current value of the SUPPORT_CHUNKING global flag
set_max_prefill_tokens: set the global MAX_PREFILL_TOKENS value to configure the maximum prefill token limit
get_max_prefill_tokens: get the current value of the MAX_PREFILL_TOKENS global configuration
review_prefill_chunking_module: review the prefill_chunking module to understand the global chunking and token limit configuration
